errors.INVALID_CUE_RANGE: A line has an invalid duration.
errors.INVALID_PROJECT: This project is invalid or has missing references.
errors.UNSUPPORTED_PROJECT_VERSION: This project version is not supported.
errors.FFPROBE_UNAVAILABLE: FFprobe was not found. Check diagnostics.
errors.FFMPEG_UNAVAILABLE: FFmpeg was not found. Check diagnostics.
errors.NO_VIDEO: This file has no video track.
errors.PROJECT_EXISTS: This project folder already exists. Choose another name.
errors.STALE_REVISION: The project has changed. Recalculate before applying synchronization.
errors.BUSY: Wait for the job to finish or cancel it.
errors.PROCESS_FAILED: Media processing failed. Check the logs.
errors.MEDIA_MISSING: Project media is missing. Import it again.
errors.MEDIA_PLAYBACK_FAILED: The player could not load the video. Try preparing a new proxy from Audio.
errors.INVALID_SUBTITLE_TRACK: This subtitle track is missing from the media.
errors.BITMAP_SUBTITLES: This track contains images. OCR conversion is required to produce SRT.
errors.EMPTY_SUBTITLE_TRACK: This track has no subtitles to import.
errors.SUBTITLE_EXTRACTION_FAILED: Subtitle extraction failed. Check the processing logs.
errors.DESKTOP_REQUIRED: This feature is available in the desktop app.
errors.ALIGNMENT_TOO_FEW: Import at least three subtitles in each SRT to estimate synchronization.
errors.ALIGNMENT_AMBIGUOUS: Matches are insufficient or ambiguous. Synchronization cannot be applied. Check the SRTs and use timecodes to correct them manually.
errors.INVALID_SPLIT: Place the playhead inside the line, at least 100 ms from either edge.
errors.NO_NEXT_DIALOGUE: There is no next line to merge.
errors.WAVEFORM_FAILED: Waveform computation failed. Check the processing panel.
errors.SAVE_FAILED: Saving failed. Retry before calculating synchronization.
errors.RUNTIME_PLATFORM_UNSUPPORTED: Automatic Bandit runtime installation is available on Windows x64 in this version.
errors.RUNTIME_REQUIRED: Install Bandit in Audio before starting separation.
errors.MODEL_CHECKSUM_FAILED: The model file does not match the expected hash. Reinstall it.
errors.DOWNLOAD_FAILED: A download could not complete. Check processing and retry.
errors.DEVICE_UNAVAILABLE: This compute device is unavailable. Choose a detected device or CPU.
errors.NO_AUDIO: The video has no selected audio track.
errors.SEPARATION_FAILED: Audio processing failed. Check logs in Processing.
errors.AUDIO_PLAYBACK_FAILED: An audio track could not load or play. Check the project files.
errors.RUNTIME_INSTALL_FAILED: The Bandit environment is incomplete. Repair its installation from Audio.
errors.DEVICE_PROBE_FAILED: GPU detection did not complete within 30 seconds. Bandit remains available on CPU. Refresh compute devices to try again.
errors.INVALID_CHARACTER: Invalid character. Check the name and color.
errors.INVALID_REFERENCE_AUDIO: A reference must contain between 0.5 and 20 seconds of valid audio.
errors.REFERENCE_FAILED: Reference extraction failed. Choose an audio file or a line with sound.
errors.SPEAKER_RUNTIME_REQUIRED: Install the speaker model from Models.
errors.SPEAKER_RUNTIME_FAILED: The speaker model is not ready. Repair it from Models.
errors.SPEAKER_ANALYSIS_FAILED: Speaker identification failed. Check the processing logs.
errors.NO_SPEECH_FOUND: No sufficiently long voice was detected in these lines. Check the audio track and subtitle timings.

loadingVideoHint: The player is preparing the first frame.
videoLoadError: The video could not be loaded.
embeddedInstructions: Choose the track to import into this SRT.
bitmapHint: Bitmap subtitles: OCR conversion is required.
embeddedConversionHint: Text tracks are converted to SRT. Advanced ASS/SSA formatting is not preserved.
extractingSubtitlesHint: Extracting and saving. Track or cancel the job from the bottom status bar.
alignmentHint: Synchronize the two SRTs by comparing their timings. The reference SRT stays in place; only matched groups of the other SRT are retimed.
alignmentSummary: {{matches}} matched groups · {{unmatched}} cues to review · estimated mean error: {{error}} ms
alignmentPreviewHint: Preview of the other SRT timings, before and after. Text is preserved.
alignmentLimit: This synchronization uses timings, without speech recognition or semantic translation matching. Listen to verify the associations. Different edits of the video may require manual corrections.
splitHint: Split at the playhead. Text distribution is approximate: review both parts.
dragHint: Drag to move · edges to resize · Shift to snap · arrows: 100 ms
waveform: Waveform of the selected audio track
graphicsHint: Application rendering preference on Windows. Windows and the driver choose the effective WebView2 GPU. Set the audio separation device in Audio.
graphicsRestart: Restart the application to apply this preference.
graphicsError: GPU information or preference could not be updated.
updatesAutomatic: Check for new versions at startup
updatesCurrent: This version is up to date.
updatesVerified: Download complete, signature verified. The project will be saved before installation.
updatesWaitJobs: Finish or cancel processing jobs before installation.
updatesError: Checking, downloading or installation failed. Retry when the connection is available.
updatesHint: Updates come from the studio GitHub repository and their signature is verified. Installation starts only at your request.
playbackMetricsHint: These counters describe video playback since loading. If playback stutters, prepare a smooth preview in Audio and compare the results.
lightPreviewHint: Create an H.264 preview limited to 720p and 30 fps, with frequent keyframes for faster seeking. The original video is retained.
separationHint: Bandit v2 Multilingual extracts speech, music and effects from the track selected at import. Processing stays on this device.
runtimeHint: Install Python and dependencies in the studio data folder, then the 447 MB model. Allow about 2 GB for CPU mode and more for CUDA. Weights: CC BY-SA 4.0; Bandit code: Apache-2.0.
runtimeModify: Modify or repair the Bandit installation
runtimeDeviceUnavailable: {{name}} is detected but cannot run CUDA operations. Reinstall NVIDIA support and check the driver.
separationQuality: Separation is an estimate and may contain leakage or artifacts. A film may take a long time on CPU. Results appear in the timeline on success; previous outputs are retained.
mixerHint: M mutes a track; S solos it. Player volume sets the master level. Separated stems replace the original during playback after separation.
charactersHint: Identify voices automatically, then name characters and correct their lines.
speakerHint: Local voice analysis of existing subtitle intervals. Uses the Bandit speech track when available. Review the proposals and enter character names manually.
speakerThresholdHint: Higher values create more groups. Short, noisy or overlapping voices may produce errors.
speakerApplyHint: Creates Speaker 1, Speaker 2… characters with a voice reference. Manually assigned lines keep their character.
speakerStale: Lines or media have changed. Run identification again before applying.
charactersEmpty: Create a character, or run AI identification after importing your subtitles.
voiceReferenceHint: Import a clear single-voice clip or extract the selected line. Maximum 20 seconds. Add several references, such as neutral, angry or whisper.
modelsHint: Install available models here. Processing stays on this device.
modelBanditHint: Speech, music and effects separation. Verified multilingual 447 MB model.
modelConfigureBandit: Install or configure Bandit in Audio
modelSpeakerHint: Groups subtitle voices with CAMPPlus and filters speech with Silero. Isolated installation with verified files and checksums.
voiceStatusHint: “Voice not generated” means this line has no generated dubbing audio. Translated subtitles may already exist. Voice generation will be added in Phase 5.
modelVoicePreference: Preferred future voice engine for this project
modelVoiceHint: This choice prepares the project. Engine installation and generation will become available in their respective phases.
subtitleImportHint: Choose an SRT file or a text subtitle stream. To translate one line, click Add a translation on its card.
autoAlignImported: Automatically synchronize the imported SRT with the other SRT
autoAlignImportedHint: Uses timings, without speech recognition. The other SRT keeps its timings. Ambiguous matches are not applied; the file remains imported.
subtitleImportedAlignmentSkipped: SRT imported. Automatic synchronization was not applied:
